purpose: Verify an executable engineering repair of the existing replay initialization interruption defect and test bounded structural strategy transfer. No consequential scientific flagship is admitted by this protocol.
unchanged_useful_objective: An interruption after exclusive output reservation must leave no COMPLETE record, must preserve partial evidence with an INTERRUPTED record, and must refuse replay into the same output without mutation. Normal successful execution must still complete the required phase order.
source_freeze: Exact builder source hashes are recorded in a separate verifier freeze receipt before selecting fresh cases. This protocol is not modified after that freeze.
development_exposure: Verifier read the legacy reproduce.py and old verification source.
Builder knows the generic fault locations and has received verifier criticism of the initialization gap.
Builder has received the generic fresh-publication family but not the exact case population or parameters.
The initial legacy interruption fault is development evidence, never confirmation.

fresh_case_plan.variation: Different labels, effect/order structures and protected-boundary locations within the supplied typed grammar. Include infeasible or incompatible transfer refusal.
fresh_case_plan.protection: Verifier chooses cases and runs the frozen candidate without editing it. Shared filesystem, host and model family mean procedural separation only; this is not external certification or OS-enforced secrecy.
fresh_case_plan.exposure_rule: After results are released to the builder these cases become exposed engineering regression evidence. Any subsequent repaired candidate must be identified separately and cannot retain freshness on these cases.

controls.strong_conventional: Wrap all post-reservation effects in one cleanup/exception boundary under the same objective and available task metadata.
controls.ordinary_reuse: Equivalent supplied source/generative content, not a weakened artifact-only cache.
controls.reset: Original late-boundary policy without the acquired repair constraint.
controls.operator_removal: Retain record metadata while removing the inherited executable generative operator.
controls.resource_rule: Use the same search bounds, task information and final invariant checks for comparable arms. Record separate generation/evaluation resource quantities; do not infer complete lifecycle cost from runtime.

engineering_gates: Original defect reproduced deterministically at STARTED exclusive creation and source identity recorded.
Repaired wrapper passes the same deterministic initialization and before-worker interruption specification.
Frozen strategy compiler constructs a valid composition under declared typed grammar and bounds; no claim of unrestricted invention.
Structural applicability checks reject incompatible causality or units and distinguish label similarity from actual compatible relations.
Actual sandbox effect/resource probes qualify before generated strategy execution is counted as confined.
Retained instrument, applicability and generative operator remain distinct; source identity and scope checked before reuse.
Fresh successor arm outcomes are reported alongside conventional and equivalent-content ordinary reuse, including ties or failures.
decision_rule: Any missing or invalid interruption marker after output reservation, a false COMPLETE marker, evidence mutation on refused replay, an unconfined generated execution, or an invalid accepted strategy fails its corresponding engineering gate. An unknown or missing comparison remains UNKNOWN. Passing these engineering gates establishes only the executed bounded scope.

statistics.scope: Deterministic engineering counterexamples and generalization checks. No statistical evidence of discovery superiority or progressive lifecycle advantage.

commercial_scope: No buyer requirements, accepted commercial delivery, price, complete cost, earned funds or commercial compounding established by this engineering test.
